settings.heading: From the indigo plant
settings.text: Our colour comes from the indigo plant — a natural dye at the heart of a craft passed down for generations in Sakon Nakhon. Every piece is dyed by hand, so no two are exactly alike.

settings.image_label: Hands at work — dipping cloth, or at the loom. Show texture and process.
settings.image_alt: Hands dyeing cloth with natural indigo
settings.heading: Made by hand
settings.text: Prepared, dyed, and woven by hand using traditional methods. The small variations in tone and pattern are the mark of real handcraft — and make every piece one of a kind.

settings.image_label: The community of makers together, or the place. Group or craft-in-context — never a single person as the brand's face.
settings.image_alt: Weavers and dyers of the Sakon Nakhon community at work
settings.heading: Made by a local community
settings.text: KRAMSAKON works hand in hand with growers, dyers, and weavers in Sakon Nakhon. As a social enterprise, we help the value of this craft return to the community that keeps it alive.

settings.intro: Pieces dyed with natural indigo and woven by hand — made to be lived with.

settings.title: The indigo plant
settings.text: Indigo is grown and harvested on the land around Sakon Nakhon.
settings.image_alt: Indigo plants growing in a field

settings.title: The indigo vat
settings.text: The vat is prepared and kept alive — tended daily, read by eye and by hand.

settings.title: Dyed by hand
settings.text: Cloth is dipped by hand, again and again, until the depth of colour is right.
